name: POST /api/billing/stripe/webhook - Stripe events (signed)
description: Stripe's webhook, authenticated by the Stripe-Signature header over the raw body (no sign-in). checkout.session.completed (paid credits -> credits added once per payment; subscription -> plan set) and customer.subscription.updated/deleted (status, period end, canceled). Each event id is handled once (a resend returns duplicate: true). A valid signature needs the webhook secret at send time, so the success paths are proved by fixture 55_billing.py; these cases prove refusals. Prices live in Stripe: the catalog is every active Stripe price tagged metadata app=medexregai with kind=plan (recurring) or kind=credits (one-time, metadata credits). Payment happens on Stripe Checkout (card data never reaches MedexRegAI); Stripe's signed webhook then sets the plan or adds the credits, once per event and once per payment. Dev uses Stripe TEST mode. Fixture 55_billing.py proves the purchase, duplicate, bad-signature, plan and cancel paths with signed test events.

errorCases.when: missing or wrong Stripe-Signature, or a body changed after signing

errorCases.message: Billing webhooks are not set up (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty).
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: The test environment has a webhook secret.
